K1.text: Magic links are now redeemed by POST, single-use and hashed, and staff sign-out bumps sessionsValidFrom, but tenant and guarantor sign-out is still a bare signOut() that never bumps the watermark, so a copied portal JWT lives out its lifetime.

K2.text: Staff password leads to a single-use MFA challenge then TOTP, enforced in auth.ts; SEC-18 moved the MFA rate limit onto the callback route. Auth.ts flow not re-traced line by line this pass.

K3.text: Two static inventories (every 'use server' export, every route) enforce guards and were edited as recently as 2026-11-02; SEC-01 fixed. Regex-based, test-backed rather than a fresh manual sweep.

K4.text: SEC-09 to SEC-15 fixed (324 entry points swept, currentScope has no default, source test over callers); only SEC-16 (unrouted inbox is portfolio-wide, a design question, struck through in the backlog) and LOWs remain.

K5.text: Postgres-backed limiter on login, MFA, reset, magic link and inquiries; not re-traced this pass.

K6.text: Tokens hashed with TTLs, X-Robots-Tag noindex on token paths, and publicListing now uses an allowlisted select; but Referrer-Policy is same-origin rather than no-referrer (deliberate) and token pages only set force-dynamic, with no Cache-Control: no-store anywhere.

K7.text: Global headers on /:path*: Referrer-Policy, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY and HSTS, plus frame-ancestors 'none' in the proxy CSP.

K8.text: SEC-05 fixed: inbound-email secret header-only with timingSafeEqual, cron compare constant-time and fails closed when unset; only .env.example is tracked as an env file. SEC-21 (deploy hook URL in git history) is a rotation item, not a code defect.

K9.text: SEC-04 fixed: Resend verifier rejects timestamps outside the shared 300s window and Stripe was already compliant; idempotent claim not re-traced.

K10.text: Console output confined to simulated adapters; notifications have a kill switch and sandbox redirect; production missing-provider behaviour not re-traced.

K11.text: assertEnv() now runs at boot and .env.example now lists every app variable except platform-set ones (NODE_ENV, VERCEL_ENV, TZ, RLS_ENFORCE), but the schema checks only 6 variables, leaving CRON_SECRET, Stripe, Twilio and webhook secrets unvalidated.

K12.text: Vitest refuses any DATABASE_URL host other than localhost/127.0.0.1 via a code-level guard, local Postgres via .env.test, e2e defaults to build + start.

K13.text: AuditLog has DB-enforced append-only and no-truncate triggers, plus the same for LedgerEntry, Message, Notice, NoticeDelivery and TenantConsent; sign-out-everywhere writes an audit row.

K14.text: vercel.json ignoreCommand anchored at the repo root diffing VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA with a build fallback; port 3100 default in playwright config; cron routes use constant-time fail-closed isAuthorizedCron (HEAD 47d46fe5, 2026-11-10).
